examples.arabic: خالتي قالتلي ان في مرشح جديد للانتخابات الكل بيتكلم عنه
examples.english: My aunt told me there's a new candidate for the elections everyone is talking about
examples.transliteration: Khaltī qāletlī inn fī morashshaḥ gedīd lel-entikhābāt el-koll biyitkallem ʿannoh

examples.arabic: الحمد لله بخير بتهيألي الانتخابات قربت
examples.english: Praise be to God, I'm fine. I think the elections are close.

examples.arabic: رديت عليها ايوه صحيح الاحزاب السياسية بتقدم مرشحين كتير للانتخابات الجاية
examples.english: I replied to her "Yes, that's right, political parties are presenting many candidates for the upcoming elections."
examples.transliteration: Raddēt ʿalēha "Aywa ṣaḥīḥ el-aḥzāb as-sīyāsīya betʾaddem morashshaḥīn ketīr lel-entikhābāt el-gāyya."
